claim_boundary: Exact low blocks only; no extrapolation to higher representations or determinant sum is encoded.

normalization.basis: component-major orthonormal one-form basis theta^a tensor |j,m>; m descends from j to -j
normalization.measure: normalized product Haar measure with positive dtheta wedge sigma1 wedge sigma2 wedge 2sigma3 orientation

priming.A_at_one_zero_interpretation: five Killing one-forms: two in n=0,j=0 and three from the one-dimensional kernel in n=0,j=1 with left multiplicity three
priming.F_zero: the n=0,j=0 dtheta one-form is the sole F harmonic mode in the oracle
priming.common_fixed_domain: for comparisons through t=1, remove the orthogonal union of the stored F and A(1) kernel projectors; retain separately listed finite zero-mode measure factors
priming.coupling: every A(1) zero in the oracle is coclosed and orthogonal to im(d), so no Schur pole is paired with these physical-t zeros
priming.scalar_zero: remove the n=0,j=0 constant before Delta_0^-1
